dependencies.required_evidence: artifact-derived q1 v2 qualification passes exact A/B roundtrips, full probability/coder/checkpoint-state identity, runtime, package, dependency, license, memory, and repeat gates with process-tree peak at most 9,000,000 KiB
frozen integer mixture law remains static-closed; its theorem is used only as an ideal-log-loss safety statement and not as archive credit
the exact opaque post-WRT template-name, explicit-key, positional-index, value-boundary, nesting, overflow, and mismatch transition is independently source-audited before reuse
no live lease or acquisition lock before any source build or substantial execution

contract.role: new decoder-visible virtual-time recurrent specialist over template-field fibers
contract.name: WIKI-LOOM
contract.scientific_question: Can one shared recurrent transition retain useful long memory when its hidden and cell state advance along decoder-visible template-field subsequences instead of the interleaved byte stream?
not_checkpointing: The authoritative parent is never snapshotted, restored, forked, rejoined, or overwritten.
No full CMIX state, context table, optimizer, arithmetic coder, or parent mixer is duplicated.
Only an auxiliary expert's recurrent hidden and cell coordinates are multiplexed; the source bytes remain in original order.
distinct_from_retired_work: Article ordering and GEPA permuted pages before the backend; WIKI-LOOM does not reorder or transmit a permutation.
FRACTAL and page-trie candidates paid copy selectors and lengths; WIKI-LOOM emits no copy command, source, length, rank, or side stream.
Typed Skip-CTS and slot tries counted short event prefixes; WIKI-LOOM advances a recurrent trajectory over the complete byte subsequence of each retained field.

The earlier parity LSTM factorization used two fixed position lanes and separately trained recurrent endpoints; WIKI-LOOM uses semantic routes, one shared parent-weight view, and a bank of hidden/cell states.
WIKI-SCHEMA-VM predicts later field keys from completed invocations; WIKI-LOOM predicts value bytes from a persistent virtual timeline keyed by the already decoded template and field identity.

causal_route.eligible_region: bytes strictly inside a template field value after its template name and either explicit key plus equals or positional index are fully decoder-visible
causal_route.parser_overflow: sleep until the parser returns to a valid bounded state; do not update a route from an overflowed descriptor
causal_route.prediction_order: resolve the descriptor and route from state through byte i-1, predict byte i, code or decode all eight bits, then advance exactly the selected auxiliary state with byte i
causal_route.same_invocation_rule: state advancement within an open field is causal, but a route that missed at field entry sleeps for that entire field; it may first predict only on a later field-entry fingerprint hit
causal_route.future_information_forbidden: field length, closing delimiter, later key, completed value, page summary, corpus counts, archive loss, and encoder-only selection

state_bank.index: low 12 bits of the frozen unsigned-64 descriptor hash
state_bank.record: 64-bit nonzero fingerprint, recurrent hidden vector, recurrent cell vector, saturated prior-field byte support, and rolling state digest
state_bank.collision: a fingerprint mismatch makes the current field sleep, then installs the new fingerprint with zero hidden/cell state after the field-entry decision; no old state is blended or consulted
state_bank.hit: exact 64-bit fingerprint equality; the implementation must also retain and compare the bounded descriptor bytes during the first gate so hash collision is a fatal malformed-evidence event
state_bank.warmth: a fingerprint hit is awake only if at least 128 bytes were accumulated before the current field entry
state_bank.weights: the auxiliary transition reads the current authoritative ByteMixer LSTM parameter matrices but never writes weights, optimizer, gradients, deferred-update buffers, or the ordinary recurrent trajectory
state_bank.advance: exactly one no-train recurrent transition after each decoded eligible byte, applied only to the selected slot
state_bank.inactive: no auxiliary recurrent transition outside a bounded eligible field

probability_endpoint.raw_D: when awake, condition the selected auxiliary 256-way byte distribution on the already decoded prefix bits of the current byte; when asleep, emit the authoritative parent count exactly
probability_endpoint.mixed_M: combine authoritative parent P and raw D through gamma_safe_mix_v1 with one global posterior over awake bits only
probability_endpoint.posterior: one persistent global posterior, no per-field or per-slot reset, and no update while D sleeps
probability_endpoint.parent: ordinary parent prediction, state, learning cadence, coder count, and coder transition remain authoritative and byte-identical in P and K

arms.P: qualified q1 parent with no parser, state bank, auxiliary recurrent transition, or mixture
arms.K: execute the exact parser, routing, state-bank, auxiliary transition, sleeping logic, and hashes but send P to the coder and forbid every mechanism-to-parent write; K must equal P
arms.D: aligned template-field state bank as the raw sleeping expert
arms.M: D wrapped by the frozen global integer SAFE-MIX against P
arms.G: one global auxiliary recurrent state with the same weights, eligible bytes, support rule, and endpoint, isolating extra recurrence from virtual semantic time
arms.S: route each field through the immediately preceding completed field descriptor while preserving the current field's eligibility, byte count, update cadence, state geometry, and endpoint
arms.R: route each field by SplitMix64(page_ordinal, invocation_ordinal, field_ordinal) into the same 4,096 slots while preserving all other transitions
arms.N: use the aligned state and replace its conditional byte distribution by the frozen byte-complement distribution before the identical endpoint
arms.repeat: a fresh process reproduces every probability, coder, route, state, posterior, payload, inverse, and resource digest

smallest_decisive_gate.population: canonical opening 10,000,000 raw bytes through an exact q1-parent source build after every dependency passes
required_evidence: P and K probability, coder-state, payload, inverse, and persistent-parent-state identity
exact finite P/K/D/M/G/S/R/N archives and raw inverses
all route descriptors decided before the first predicted field-value byte
D and M positive in each chronological third
M net gain after compressed incremental source and framing at least 50,000 bytes
D ideal finite loss beats G, S, R, and N by at least 10,000 byte-equivalent each
process-tree, cgroup, scratch, runtime, and dependency closure
smallest_decisive_gate.promotion: one distant 10M transfer using the unchanged source and constants; only a positive distant result may authorize cumulative 100M
smallest_decisive_gate.retirement: retire this exact parser route, 4,096-slot geometry, 128-byte warmth, shared-weight no-train transition, and global mixture if any exactness gate fails, M net is below 50,000 bytes, a third is nonpositive, or any control margin misses; do not sweep slots, warmth, route keys, state width, or mixture scope

promotion_ladder: cumulative 100M exact archive and resource gate
full 1G A/B encode, exact inverse, deterministic repeat, package, runtime, memory, dependency, and counted-score proof

resource_bounds.rule: A standalone state-bank estimate cannot grant memory authority; every promoted scope measures the full parent plus mechanism process tree and cgroup.

activation_requirements: The plan and Mechanism IR validate against their registered schemas.
The q1 v2 artifact-derived router grants promotion authority at the 9,000,000 KiB engineering headroom target.
The live exclusive_full1g lease and its acquisition lock are absent.
A source audit freezes the exact parent LSTM read set, no-train forward transition, hidden/cell serialization, byte conditionalization, parser transition, hash, collision, and parent-write exclusion.
Gamma Mechanism IR v3 compiles a verified P/K/D/M/R/S causal closure after the lease clears; G and N receive separately matched native manifests.
All source, build, package, population, command, guard, schema, and output identities are content-addressed before execution.
claim_boundary: WIKI-LOOM is a zero-credit design; no source, compiled closure, probability trace, archive, inverse, resource receipt, or measured saving exists.
The 50,000-byte opening gate is a preregistered target-bearing threshold, not a forecast.
SAFE-MIX can state an ideal-log-loss envelope only; exact integer archives decide compression.
This proposal does not change the 108,513,707-byte external baseline, the 3,513,707-byte debt, Gamma authorship credit, or Gamma score credit.
